SELECT (SELECT A.TRANS_STATUS FROM INTG_INTERFACE_TRANS A WHERE A.SCHEDULE_CODE = CASE WHEN M.SCHEDULE_CODE = 'NON_SCHEDULE' THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE M.SCHEDULE_CODE END AND A.COMPANY_CODE = M.COMPANY_CODE AND A.INTG_INTERFACE_TRANS_ID = (SELECT MAX(INTG_INTERFACE_TRANS_ID) FROM INTG_INTERFACE_TRANS A WHERE A.SCHEDULE_CODE = CASE WHEN M.SCHEDULE_CODE = 'NON_SCHEDULE' THEN 'MANUAL' ELSE M.SCHEDULE_CODE END AND A.COMPANY_CODE = M.COMPANY_CODE)) AS TRANSFER_STATUS ,M.* FROM INTERFACE_SCHEDULE M WHERE M.SCHEDULE_CODE IN ('NON_SCHEDULE', 'DAILY_BATCH', 'MONTHLY_BATCH') AND COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}
SELECT AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, AUTHOR_GROUP_NM, AUTHOR_GROUP_DC, USE_AT, START_PAGE_URL FROM COM_AUTHOR_GROUP WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO COM_AUTHOR_GROUP AG USING (SELECT #{AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE} AS AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE , #{AUTHOR_GROUP_NM} AS AUTHOR_GROUP_NM , #{COMPANY_CODE} AS COMPANY_CODE , #{AUTHOR_GROUP_DC} AS AUTHOR_GROUP_DC , #{USE_AT} AS USE_AT , #{START_PAGE_URL} AS START_PAGE_URL , #{USER_ID} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL) I ON (AG.COMPANY_CODE = I.COMPANY_CODE AND AG.AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE = I.AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AG.AUTHOR_GROUP_NM = I.AUTHOR_GROUP_NM , AG.AUTHOR_GROUP_DC = I.AUTHOR_GROUP_DC , AG.USE_AT = I.USE_AT , AG.START_PAGE_URL = I.START_PAGE_URL , AG.UPDATE_BY = I.USER_ID , AG.IF_TARGET_YN = 'Y' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , AUTHOR_GROUP_NM , AUTHOR_GROUP_DC , USE_AT , START_PAGE_URL , IF_TARGET_YN , CREATE_DATE , CREATE_BY , UPDATE_DATE , UPDATE_BY) VALUES ( I.AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE , I.COMPANY_CODE , I.AUTHOR_GROUP_NM , I.AUTHOR_GROUP_DC , I.USE_AT , I.START_PAGE_URL , 'Y' , SYSDATE , I.USER_ID , SYSDATE , I.USER_ID)
mapper.select: SELECT '<option value="' || A.MENU_ID || CASE WHEN X.MENU_ID IS NULL THEN '"' ELSE '" selected' END || '>' || CASE WHEN PARENT_ID IS NULL THEN '[Folder]' ELSE '     [Link' END || '-' || A.MENU_ID || '] ' || A.MENU_DESC || '</option>' AS DATA_TAG FROM (SELECT ROWNUM AS SORT_NO, LEVEL AS DEPTH, M.MENU_ID AS MENU_ID, M.PARENT_MENU_ID AS PARENT_ID, M.MENU_DESC, M.LINK_URL, M.MENU_SE, M.USING_YN, M.SORT_NO AS SSS FROM COM_MENU M WHERE M.USING_YN = 'Y' CONNECT BY PARENT_MENU_ID = PRIOR MENU_ID START WITH PARENT_MENU_ID IS NULL ORDER SIBLINGS BY M.SORT_NO ASC) A LEFT OUTER JOIN COM_AUTHOR_MENU X ON A.MENU_ID = X.MENU_ID AND X.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND X.AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE = #{AUTHOR_GROUP_CODE} WHERE A.USING_YN = 'Y'

mapper.select:
SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, LEVEL AS DEPTH, M.MENU_ID AS id, M.PARENT_MENU_ID AS PARENT_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_DESC, M.LINK_URL, M.MENU_SE, M.USING_YN, M.SORT_NO AS SORT_NO, M.MENU_ID, NVL(M.PARENT_MENU_ID, '') AS PARENT_MENU_ID FROM COM_MENU M

MERGE INTO SALES_MST T USING ( SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_CODE, A.DIVISION_CODE, A.SALES_NO, A.ARRIVAL_NATION, A.ARRIVAL_PORT_NAME, A.BL_NO, A.COUNT_UNIT, A.CUSTOMER_CODE, A.DELETE_YN, A.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE, A.DEPARTMENT_CODE, A.DEPARTURE_PORT_NAME, A.EXPORT_DECLARE_DATE, A.EXPORT_DECLARE_NO, A.EXPORT_FLAG, A.INCOTERMS, A.INVOICE_DATE, A.INVOICE_NO, A.PACKING_COUNT, A.PACKING_MARK, A.SHIPPING_DATE, A.TOTAL_WEIGHT, A.VEHICLE_NAME, A.IF_YN, A.CREATE_DATE FROM SALES_MST_INF A INNER JOIN SALES_DTL_INF B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.SALES_NO = B.SALES_NO WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.${TARGET_COL} BETWEEN #{FROM_DATE} AND #{TO_DATE} ) P ON (T.COMPANY_CODE = P.COMPANY_CODE AND T.DIVISION_CODE = P.DIVISION_CODE AND T.SALES_NO = P.SALES_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.ARRIVAL_NATION = P.ARRIVAL_NATION, T.ARRIVAL_PORT_NAME = P.ARRIVAL_PORT_NAME, T.BL_NO = P.BL_NO, T.COUNT_UNIT = P.COUNT_UNIT, T.CUSTOMER_CODE = P.CUSTOMER_CODE, T.DELETE_YN = P.DELETE_YN, T.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE = P.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE, T.DEPARTMENT_CODE = P.DEPARTMENT_CODE, T.DEPARTURE_PORT_NAME = P.DEPARTURE_PORT_NAME, T.EXPORT_DECLARE_DATE = P.EXPORT_DECLARE_DATE, T.EXPORT_DECLARE_NO = P.EXPORT_DECLARE_NO, T.EXPORT_FLAG = P.EXPORT_FLAG, T.INCOTERMS = P.INCOTERMS, T.INVOICE_DATE = P.INVOICE_DATE, T.INVOICE_NO = P.INVOICE_NO, T.PACKING_COUNT = P.PACKING_COUNT, T.PACKING_MARK = P.PACKING_MARK, T.SHIPPING_DATE = P.SHIPPING_DATE, T.TOTAL_WEIGHT = P.TOTAL_WEIGHT, T.VEHICLE_NAME = P.VEHICLE_NAME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, SALES_NO, ARRIVAL_NATION, ARRIVAL_PORT_NAME, BL_NO, COUNT_UNIT, CUSTOMER_CODE, DELETE_YN, DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTURE_PORT_NAME, EXPORT_DECLARE_DATE, EXPORT_DECLARE_NO, EXPORT_FLAG, INCOTERMS, INVOICE_DATE, INVOICE_NO, PACKING_COUNT, PACKING_MARK, SHIPPING_DATE, TOTAL_WEIGHT, VEHICLE_NAME) VALUES (P.COMPANY_CODE, P.DIVISION_CODE, P.SALES_NO, P.ARRIVAL_NATION,P.ARRIVAL_PORT_NAME,P.BL_NO,P.COUNT_UNIT ,P.CUSTOMER_CODE,P.DELETE_YN,P.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE,P.DEPARTMENT_CODE,P.DEPARTURE_PORT_NAME,P.EXPORT_DECLARE_DATE ,P.EXPORT_DECLARE_NO,P.EXPORT_FLAG,P.INCOTERMS,P.INVOICE_DATE,P.INVOICE_NO,P.PACKING_COUNT,P.PACKING_MARK ,P.SHIPPING_DATE,P.TOTAL_WEIGHT,P.VEHICLE_NAME)
